title: The Protocol of New Lagos
author: Dominic Hartwell
blurb: Isandro Vane, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
